findings.summary: 19 of the 29 target AI Skills catalog entries (social-content, paid-ads, onboarding-cro, launch-strategy, copywriting, analytics-tracking, ad-creative, campaign-plan, performance-report, seo-audit, postiz, automation-audit, automation-builder, audience-health, campaign-report, campaign-strategy, contact-operations, deals-crm, reporting-analysis) have zero repository presence under any name or legacy alias -- MISSING_BUT_REQUIRED, no provable product-intent contract exists to implement them without inventing behavior
findings.justification: MISSING_BUT_REQUIRED per target catalog; no product spec proves trigger/input/output for any of the 19, so implementing now would invent product behavior (forbidden by this mission's own rules). Accepted as backlog debt pending an explicit product decision in the next mission.

findings.summary: Two parallel AI-execution paths exist: the canonical audited backend AI Skills (packages/ai-skills registry -> apps/api/src/core/automation loader/executor -> skill_runs audit trail, tenant-scoped, idempotent) and a separate frontend-only path (musicIntelligenceEngine/ + marketing/ai/providers/providerRouter.ts consumed by IACriativa.tsx) that calls an LLM provider directly from the client with no skill_runs audit record, no idempotency key, and no packages/ai-skills contract -- not one of the 29 catalog entries, and not reconciled against it. Not fixed in this mission per its own scope boundary (no product-finding remediation); recorded for the next mission.
findings.justification: Real architectural duplication finding, but fixing/reconciling it is product-finding remediation, explicitly out of scope for this mission (terminal instruction: stop after final report, no remediation). Deferred to the next mission, which the operator has already said will use this mission's outputs.
